_about: The Uniswap v4 ETH/IMD pool that Zap swaps on, as read from Ethereum mainnet. The key and the id are fixed facts; the reading drifts and is recorded only to show the pool was live and liquid when this was written.
_source: poolId = keccak256(abi.encode(key)); reading from StateView 0x7fFE42C4a5DEeA5b0feC41C94C136Cf115597227 getSlot0 / getLiquidity over https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com
